supplied_real_identity_images.note: MyKad 6/6, MyPR 7/7, Malaysia Passport 15/15 on user-supplied image fixtures.

defects_found_and_fixed.issue: SSM Company Profile official sample was under-detected as generic SSM Document and the modern registration number format was truncated.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Expanded official Malay/English company-profile labels, modern/legacy SSM number parsing, dual-address fields and optional-field strictness.
defects_found_and_fixed.verification: SSM Company Profile now 13/13 structured fields exact on the fresh source-derived test.

defects_found_and_fixed.issue: SSM Business Registration English certificate labels were not fully covered and Certificate Date could consume the registrar text.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Added English FORM D/certificate label support, principal-place-of-business parsing and bounded date capture.
defects_found_and_fixed.verification: SSM Business Registration now 6/6 structured fields exact on visible test values.

defects_found_and_fixed.issue: Malaysia Passport visual identity number with hyphens was removed by strict sanitisation and issuing office containing a spaced hyphen could be rejected.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Accept Malaysian NRIC punctuation then canonicalise to 12 digits for passport identity number; location parser now ignores punctuation-only tokens.
defects_found_and_fixed.verification: Fresh Firefly passport visible fields now 12/12 exact.

defects_found_and_fixed.issue: Generic CAAM pilot licence was classified as General Document because detector matched “licence no” but not “Licence Number”/pilot licence.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Expanded generic Certificate/Licence detection to licence number and pilot licence wording.
defects_found_and_fixed.verification: CAAM sample now correctly detects Certificate / Licence and 10/10 visible anchors pass.

accuracy_statement: The executed fresh corpus achieved 100.00% exact-match on checked visible anchors, structured fields and document-type detection. Mean raw Tesseract token confidence was 93.72%. This does not establish a universal 99.99% accuracy or confidence guarantee for unseen production documents. Strict profiles remain fail-closed to REVIEW REQUIRED where mandatory evidence is missing, redacted or not independently verifiable.
